checks.detail: 9 focused tests pass on the locked runtime: the 5 existing offline two-cycle proofs plus 4 new final-holdout exclusion tests (taint_in rejection, taint_out rejection, catchability as RuntimeError, and the synthetic one-cycle projection that stays holdout-free while a non-holdout AccessEvent remains expressible).
The T11 diff touches exactly one owned file: tests/test_control_plane_campaign_two_cycle.py (imports plus 4 tests); no unrelated module, dependency, or forbidden path changed.

The slice performs no I/O, no subprocesses, and no real provider or data access; AccessEvent construction fails before any artifact or journal write, and the projection assertion reads only the synthetic offline journal.

A 1,573-test regression run across 48 modules passes on the locked runtime, including the entire control-plane suite with the modified two-cycle module, automation resilience, capital projection, CLI entry guards, legacy harness quarantine, promotion provenance, and AG2 orchestration/tool-loop/memory/model/file-security tests.
Spec and quality reviewer actor ids are distinct from the task actor and from each other; invocation ids are recorded; external usage is declared UNKNOWN.

advisories.detail: The new tests characterize the existing P3 access contract rather than adding production behavior; later composition slices remain responsible for wiring the access gate into dry-run namespaces.
The projection assertion covers the committed learning packet and excluded-claims surfaces; nested operational journal bytes are covered by the existing journal replay tests.
